turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want a winter project to help me start seeds earlier next year.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll tell you all the choices first. Wait until I'm finished before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A small glass greenhouse would be the dream, but it costs a lot and needs a flat base.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A wooden cold frame is cheap, and I could probably build it myself from old windows.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a polytunnel, which gives tons of space but I'm worried it looks ugly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all of them. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The cold frame is the easy win, cheap, quick and fine for hardening off seedlings. A greenhouse is lovely and lasts, but it's a bigger project with that base. The polytunnel gives you the most growing room for the money, if you can live with the look.
